findings.evidence: LinkStar.lean:189 `@[simp] theorem deletion_empty`; new lemma at Link.lean rewrites the top-face deletion to its boundary normal form with no side condition.
findings.issue: deletion_simplex_self : deletion (simplex V) V = simplexBoundary V is an unconditional normal-form computation directly parallel to deletion_empty/closedStar_empty/link_empty in LinkStar.lean, all of which are @[simp], yet it is not annotated.

findings.evidence: Link.lean self-cases at lines ~115,123 are @[simp]; the general formulas at lines ~30,42,73 are not, despite being the load-bearing computations for the recursive link condition.
findings.fix: Add @[simp] to closedStar_simplex, link_simplex, and link_simplexBoundary so the standard-model links reduce automatically downstream (matching closedStar_empty/link_empty at LinkStar.lean:174,181).
findings.issue: closedStar_simplex, link_simplex, and link_simplexBoundary are the characteristic normal-form computations (each rewrites link/closedStar of a standard model to a simplex/boundary), but carry no @[simp]; only the fully-reducing self-cases (link_simplex_self, link_simplexBoundary_self) do. They are conditional on σ ⊆ V, which simp can discharge from context via the hypothesis.

findings.evidence: Docstring on the theorem in the diff.
findings.fix: Drop or rewrite the second sentence; the first sentence (nonempty ρ with ρ ∪ σ ⊂ V) already states the content.
findings.issue: Docstring of exposed lemma mem_closedStar_simplexBoundary ends with the meaningless phrase 'supported away from no entire complementary face', which misdescribes the statement for consumers.

summary: API surface and characteristic lemmas are complete and bodies stay hidden, but the principal value-computation lemmas lack the @[simp] annotation carried by their analogues in LinkStar.lean and Basic.lean.
